maximum_depth_rule: All 336 canonical Phase 9 Reviewed statements remain raw maximum-depth records until major goals, achievement targets, projects, regional indicators, values, periods, units, and source roles can be mapped through reviewed table-level evidence.
hierarchy_boundary: The forty major goals, policy-level achievement targets, New Era Creation Projects, and regional-plan indicators remain separate hierarchy and responsibility layers.
evaluation_boundary: Annual progress and the official A, B, C, D, and no-judgment policy evaluation classes remain source classifications. Unknown or no-judgment values are not converted to failure or zero.
series_boundary: Current, target, national-comparison, multi-year, and related-strategy target-year values remain separate until definitions, units, periods, and populations are reviewed.
non_goals: Do not fill the zero-row basic-goals document by inference.
Do not merge major goals, achievement targets, projects, and regional indicators.
Do not convert no-judgment or unknown evaluation values into failure or zero.
Do not automatically merge current, target, national, and multi-year values.
Do not replace missing units or split multiple values by inference.
Do not calculate policy causality or cross-prefecture ranking.
